notes: The notification, the lock-screen buttons and the home-screen widget follow a song played straight from the catalogue, and every press there - play, pause, next, previous, the 30-second jumps and the seek bar - reaches that song instead of the download player behind it.

Crop works on a song played straight from the catalogue: hold it in its list, pick Crop a clip, drag the two ends and the part you keep is saved to your library as a song you can play, crop again, share and export.

A song paused straight from the catalogue is picked back up by the widget at the second it stopped on, that same song comes back on the bar after the app is closed, and leaving the lock screen alone no longer hands the card to a download that is not playing.
